workflow.asset_naming: Descriptive snake_case filenames, no per-focus subdirectories.
workflow.composition_delivery: Display in chat only. Leave the generated composition outside the mod; do not copy it into the mod.
workflow.prompt_storage: Append future focus prompts to this file instead of creating per-focus prompt files.
workflow.existing_prompt_records: Exact prompts and metadata are retained below, including earlier composition filenames. These filenames are historical identifiers, not instructions to save compositions in the mod.

shared_asset_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE isolated asset for a compact HOI4 national focus collage. Subject and viewpoint: {subject_and_viewpoint}. Use gritty photoreal cutout materials with restrained coarse printed grain, deep charcoal violet shadows, selective cold silver edge highlights and muted burgundy accents where appropriate. Prioritize a strong silhouette and large forms readable at 150px. Preserve the specified object, anatomy, perspective and reference design. Keep the complete object within transparent margins. True transparent alpha background, including gaps. No scene, floor, broad haze, frame, lettering, invented insignia or additional props unless explicitly requested.
shared_composition_prompt: Use case: compositing. Combine the THREE supplied separate assets for focus {focus_name}. Main action or subject: {primary_element}; supporting meaning: {secondary_element}; symbol, movement or color accent: {third_element}. Build a dense asymmetric cutout collage with clear overlaps and deliberately different scales, one dominant element and a compact broad irregular silhouette. Use the supplied designs and unify their lighting. Gritty photoreal HOI4 focus style with strong light-dark contrast, selective edge highlights, deep charcoal violet shadows and restrained color accents. Keep all three elements readable at 150px and fully inside transparent margins. True alpha outside the silhouette and in gaps. No catalogue row, full background scene, extra objects, text, border or broad glow plate.
reference_rules: Read the actual focus meaning before choosing objects.
Use the mod references for Khan uniforms, faces and flags; do not invent replacement emblems.
Use supplied angle references to match projected geometry, not merely rotate texture or writing.
Not every focus needs a person. Choose objects that communicate its action.
Specific user instructions and asset requirements override the general template.
